newsitem.title: CANADA: IPL says no space rationing on line for May.
newsitem.headline: IPL says no space rationing on line for May.

text.p: IPL Energy Inc unit Interprovincial Pipe Line Inc said on Tuesday that no apportionment would be necessary on any of its crude oil and petroleum pipelines for May.
The calculation followed a month of cuts in oil movement to the U.S. Midwest from Canada due to operational problems on the system.
Apportionment is the amount of oil expected to move on the pipeline system subtracted from shipper nominations.

The company said it was able accommodate growing volumes of heavy oil on its system in May without rationing pipeline space by moving one grade of heavy crude, Bow River Blend, to Line 13 from Line 3. It also planned to transport all mixed-blend sweet crude on Line 2.
Line 3 has carried the bulk of Canadian heavy oil grades to Superior, Wisconsin from Edmonton and in April was apportioned by six percent.
"This will free up space on Line 3 for the movement of increasing volumes of heavy crude," IPL said.
Lines 2 and 3 extend to Superior from Edmonton. Line 13 runs to Clearbrook, Minnestoa from Hardisty, Alberta. ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
